_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, so a later edit to scene.narration can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

open.text: A photograph has no depth. Your own server works it out.

drop-media.text: Open the viewer. Drop in a photo, a burst, or a video.

choose-engine.text: Pick an engine and an intent, or leave both on auto.

job-running.text: The server reads the input, picks an engine, and runs the job.

from-memory.text: Your Companion already holds your photos. Turn one into 3D without uploading anything.

engines.text: Six engines behind one interface, now including monocular depth. Preview needs no GPU at all.

explore-gallery.text: Finished assets land in the gallery. Click one to open it.

orbit-memory.text: Hide the panel and orbit the memory itself. Nothing left your hardware to render it.

magic-window.text: Turn on XR and your webcam tracks your head. The screen stops being a picture and becomes a window.

share-link.text: The address bar is the share link. It points at your box.

companion-native.text: Agents create and share these over MCP. The files stay on your hardware.

close.text: Photo Time Machine, from Companion Intelligence. UnCloud your life.
